skillInstructions: Use Agent Fleet 0.8.62 for bounded delegation and independent acceptance. Qwen high architecture uses canonical runtime ID qwen3.8-max; provider snapshot qwen3.8-max-0902 is provenance only and must not be passed as a CLI model ID. Qwen Code GLM 5.2 is not an automatic route. Local Qwen aliases are bounded one-slot implementation lanes with readiness, digest, capacity, tool, and wall-time gates. Use exact Gemini 3.8 Flash, Grok 4.6, Muse Spark 1.3, MiniMax M3, and OpenCode GLM 5.3 Flash identities; preserve the Muse Contributor deny and never bypass provider or workspace safety gates.
